question_cn: 三兵对三兵，侧翼突破成功的条件是：
question_en: Three vs. three pawns — conditions for a successful wing breakthrough are:

options.text_cn: 王的位置优势 + 兵形的牺牲突破机会同时具备
options.text_en: King positional advantage + pawn sacrifice breakthrough opportunity both present

options.text_cn: 只要有多余的一步就能突破
options.text_en: Any single extra tempo is enough to break through

options.text_cn: 兵数量相等时不能突破
options.text_en: When pawn numbers are equal, breakthrough is impossible

explanation_cn: 侧翼突破的元思维：不是靠蛮力，而是靠时机——王占优势位置（中心或关键格）+ 特定兵形（可以牺牲换通路）同时出现时才是突破时机。两个条件缺一不可。
explanation_en: Meta-concept: breakthrough requires two conditions simultaneously — king on a superior square AND a pawn sacrifice opportunity. Neither condition alone is sufficient.
